rule.purpose: Equal item spacing geometry with two keyed years at each chronological rank; removes the previously observed universal second-earliest rule in this proposed set.
rule.selection_basis: Enumerated all balanced rank assignments; rejected candidate years before 1901 and options in or after McClintock's death year 1992 or Maathai's death year 2011; retained assignments for which every one of nine declared heuristic rules scores at most 2/8 even under favorable tie resolution. Selected the retained assignment with the smallest SHA-256 of its compact JSON rank list. This public deterministic choice is not a hidden-target draw or a participant assignment.
rule.reviewer_serialization: Options are sorted by year for inspection; the runtime must independently randomize displayed positions as already specified in session-scripts.md.
rule.do_not_know: Preserved outside the four substantive options; no timing or scoring change.

limits: The nine tested rules were used to construct P2; passing them is not independent or held-out evidence. Unexamined strategies can still succeed.
Equal rank counts do not establish equal difficulty, distractor plausibility, chance-level performance or freedom from all heuristics.
All proposed spans are 11 years versus the original 21 years; this could change difficulty and needs independent disposition.
Known rank balancing can support cross-item elimination when some answers are known; no feedback alone does not remove that possibility.
Historical-era, last-digit, cross-item and prior-knowledge cues may remain; no participant data were collected.
Only reviewer-side static permutations were enumerated; no runtime randomization, projection or security implementation was tested.
Human source, rights, methods, statistical, ethics, cultural, accessibility and security reviews remain outstanding.
